detail: web-b-15.e2e.ts: body 'See #al-diff, then al-diff, then `al-diff`, then `#al-diff`, and #align too.' renders 4 a[href=/map/al-diff] reading '#al-diff' with monospace code, one '#align' link, and the prose outside links is 'See , then , then , then , and  too.'. Clicking the second link goes to /map/al-diff and the h1 shows the al-diff card title.

Lines written as separate paragraphs (blank line between) plus a heading '# al-diff' and a line 'Then #al-diff on its own.'. --al-diff, ##al-diff, &al-diff, #no-such-card and the URL paragraph have no link; the code span has no link; h1 'al-diff' has no link; the only link in the body is the standalone #al-diff to /map/al-diff.

Four fences render as 4 .codebox elements. zsh box has .codebox-tag 'zsh' and >=3 distinct span colours; TS 'const' span colour differs from the code colour that 'n' takes; cobol box labelled 'cobol' with no token spans. The untagged long-line pre has scrollWidth>clientWidth with overflow-x auto, document does not widen (1280px viewport); '#al-diff' added at the end of the long line stays code text, no <a> in any box.

Body shows '<script>window.__pwned = true</script>' as text, no <script> element in the body, window.__pwned is undefined; 'bold' has computed font-weight >=600 and 'gone' has text-decoration-line line-through.

Summary = the card's why (the grid tile shows title and why; the why is the summary line). Chat message from the pane: .msg.user has one link '#al-diff' to /map/al-diff and '#old-idea' (seeded node.removed) is plain. Scripted fake agent streams an unclosed ```json fence, pauses 2.5s: the reply shows a .codebox tagged 'json' with the partial code, then the full code with tok-key/tok-lit colours. Tile a[data-tile=tile-card] shows 'Depends on #al-diff' with no <a> inside, and a click opens /map/tile-card.

Viewport 1100px makes #header < 700px wide. From '/' the person clicks the root card in the What column, then tiles a, b, c, d. The crumbs line children read ['…','›','Card c','›','Card d'], the open card has font-weight >=600 and the line is one segment high. Hover shows [data-role=crumbs-full] with Home, Root, Card a..Card d; clicking 'Card c' in the line opens /map/c and the line ends with bold 'Card c'.

Root children: open, proto (with one decided child), a reopened card, and a decided card that depends on it (stale). On /map/root the header has data-count total, open, proto, decided whose values sum to total, no value '0', and each title names its status (stale count present too). Clicking the proto tile changes the counts to total 2, proto 1, decided 1, and no open count.

Seeded #werk, 8 ids starting 'werk-', 5 ids containing '-werk'; werk-a is stale (depends on reopened werk-b). Typing '#werk' lists <=12 role=option rows (more than 9), first is werk, all 'werk*' rows come before the 'contains' rows, each has a dot, title and id; werk-a's dot is rgb(220, 38, 38). ArrowDown then ArrowUp selects row 1 again; Enter opens /map/werk, the crumb aria-current reads 'werk itself' in bold, and the search box is empty.

On /map/invoice the Map tab has aria-current=page. Clicking Board goes to /board, [data-view=board] shows and Board tab is current; after page.reload() the board still shows; clicking Map returns to /map/invoice with h1 'The invoice'.

Root why set by a node.bodyEdited event; #how added with a child. On '/', [data-column=what] and [data-column=how] share y, have equal width and do not overlap; each shows its h2 title, data-field=why text, a rollup line '... 2 cards' and its child tile. A second fresh project with no #how shows article[data-empty=true] 'Build rules' / 'No build rules yet' in the how column.

Body mentions #al-diff, #ghost-card, bare al-diff, bare align and a code span 'node src/cli.ts show #al-diff'. Exactly two links to /map/al-diff (the #al-diff and the bare al-diff); '#ghost-card' and 'align' have no link; the code span has no link inside and is not inside a link.
pr-iface why 'Builds on #al-diff for the review'. Clicking the link inside [data-field=why] opens /map/al-diff, h1 'Alignment diff', and the why field reads 'Diff the alignment' (summary = why).

Heading h1 'al-diff' with no link; the URL paragraph has no /map/al-diff link; the fenced block code reads '#al-diff' and pre has no <a>; the code span `#al-diff` renders as one link to /map/al-diff reading '#al-diff'.

Tile a[data-tile=ref-card] why reads 'Follows up on #al-diff' with no <a> inside; a click opens /map/ref-card; the note (seeded note.added 'See al-diff first') in [data-section=thread] holds an a[href=/map/al-diff].

A ```json block with a nested object at 4-space indents and a 400-char line renders in a styled .codebox with >=2 token colours; the code textContent equals the source exactly (indentation kept) and pre white-space is pre. The pre has scrollWidth>clientWidth and scrollLeft moves >0; the body and its paragraph stay within the article width and the document does not widen.
